title: Beaver wood store + take-too-much sabotage
detail: Beavers harvest wood into their OWN store; hamsters tap it when colony wood is low. Sustained over-tapping sours them (beaverMood falls) -> they sabotage the dams (water flow drops) and spill wood. Keep colony wood stocked to keep them content. 🦫 env chip + 4 smoke checks.
